sourceConflictNote: The School Year Overview lists 'Friday, March 11, 2027' for the middle- and high-school third-quarter ending, but March 11 is Thursday; Friday is March 12, which Rockwood separately lists as a no-school professional-development day. This page retains the district's printed date, March 11, and flags the weekday mismatch. Rockwood's district Start and Dismissal Times page and Marquette High list March 22 as a high school late start, while Eureka, Lafayette, and Rockwood Summit list March 29. Because the official sources conflict, neither March date is exported in the ICS file. Rockwood lists May 28 as an Early Dismissal/Grade Recording Day, and its calendar announcement says the 2026–27 school year ends May 28; this page therefore identifies it as the final scheduled K–11 student day.

The overview supplies districtwide student dates and AMI rules; Start and Dismissal Times supplies level-specific early-dismissal times and the district's high school late-start dates.

Seven high school late-start dates agree across the district and school schedules. Marquette High matches the district's March 22 date, while Eureka, Lafayette, and Rockwood Summit currently list March 29; neither March date is included in the ICS file.
Rockwood lists the middle and high school third-quarter ending as Friday, March 11, 2027, although March 11 is Thursday and March 12 is separately listed as a no-school professional-development day.
Rockwood labels May 28 as an Early Dismissal/Grade Recording Day, and the district's calendar announcement identifies May 28 as the end of the 2026–27 school year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Rockwood School District start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students is Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Rockwood Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 23, 2026 through January 4, 2027. January 4 is also a teacher workday, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Rockwood Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Rockwood separately lists Friday, March 26 as a no-school Spring Holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Rockwood's last day of school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finish Friday, May 7, 2027. Friday, May 28 is the final scheduled K–11 student day and an early-dismissal and grade-recording day.

calendarFaqs.q: How do Rockwood snow days and AMI affect the last day?
calendarFaqs.a: Closure days one through four cause no last-day change. Days five through nine become AMI days. At ten or more closure days, Rockwood says the district calendar will be adjusted.
